f.title: Technical Director must appoint a PV responsible person and alternate resident in Uruguay
f.statement: The Technical Directorate of the laboratory must appoint a pharmacovigilance responsible person and an alternate, both residing in Uruguay, who will be the valid contacts with the Ministry of Public Health on pharmacovigilance matters.
f.clause: Anexo, II. Funciones y responsabilidades, d. Laboratorios responsables de los productos bajo su representación, i

rows.actor: Technical Director (Dirección Técnica) of the laboratory
rows.quote: i. La Dirección Técnica deberá nombrar un responsable de farmacovigilancia y su alterno, que residan en Uruguay y que serán los interlocutores válidos ante el Ministerio de Salud Pública en materia de farmacovigilancia.
rows.location: Anexo, II. Funciones y responsabilidades, d. Laboratorios responsables de los productos bajo su representación, i
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: i. The Technical Directorate shall appoint a pharmacovigilance responsible person and an alternate, residing in Uruguay, who shall be the valid contacts with the Ministry of Public Health on pharmacovigilance matters.

f.title: Use the eReporting Industria platform as the single notification system
f.statement: The laboratory must notify according to the established routes and deadlines and, to do so, must implement the "eReporting industria" platform as its single notification system.

rows.actor: Laboratory responsible for the products it represents (marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay)
rows.quote: ii. Notificar de acuerdo a las vías y plazos establecidos, en base a las siguientes especificaciones: 1. Implementar la plataforma "eReporting industria" como sistema único de notificación.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: ii. Notify according to the established routes and deadlines, on the basis of the following specifications: 1. Implement the "eReporting industria" platform as the single notification system.

f.title: Implement MedDRA and WHODrug coding and obtain the licences
f.statement: The laboratory must implement the MedDRA and WHODrug coding systems, obtaining the corresponding licences from the competent organisations.

rows.actor: Laboratory responsible for the products it represents (marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay)
rows.quote: 2 . Implementar los sistemas de codificación MedDRA y WHODrug, tramitando las licencias correspondientes ante los organismos competentes.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 2. Implement the MedDRA and WHODrug coding systems, processing the corresponding licences with the competent bodies.

f.title: Implement eReporting Industria, MedDRA and WHODrug within 180 calendar days of approval
f.statement: The laboratory must comply with items 1 (eReporting Industria as the single notification system) and 2 (MedDRA and WHODrug with licences) within no more than 180 calendar days from the approval of this Ordinance. The approval date is not stated in the captured text.

rows.actor: Laboratory responsible for the products it represents (marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay)
rows.deadline: Within 180 calendar days from approval of the Ordinance
rows.quote: 3 . Dar cumplimiento a lo establecido en los ítems 1 y 2, en un plazo no mayor de 180 (ciento ochenta) días corridos a partir de la aprobación de la presente Ordenanza.
rows.review_note: Review: días corridos = calendar days. The Ordinance approval date is not in the captured text (signature block has no date), so no compliance date recorded. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 3. Comply with items 1 and 2 within a period of no more than 180 (one hundred and eighty) calendar days from the approval of this Ordinance.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Implementation of eReporting Industria and MedDRA/WHODrug coding

f.title: Send notifications through eReporting Industria following the MSP user manual
f.statement: The laboratory must send notifications using the "eReporting Industria" tool in accordance with the instructions in the "Manual para el uso de la herramienta eReporting Industria", available on the Pharmacovigilance Unit website.

rows.actor: Laboratory responsible for the products it represents (marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay)
rows.quote: 4 . Enviar las notificaciones mediante la herramienta "eReporting Industria" de acuerdo con las instrucciones establecidas en el "Manual para el uso de la herramienta eReporting Industria", disponible en el sitio web de la Unidad de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 4. Send notifications through the "eReporting Industria" tool in accordance with the instructions set out in the "Manual for the use of the eReporting Industria tool", available on the Pharmacovigilance Unit website.

f.title: Participate in other PV activities defined by the ministerial authorities
f.statement: The laboratory must participate in other activities that may be defined by the ministerial authorities or arise from coordinated work among the actors of the National Pharmacovigilance System.
f.topic: Cooperation with the national PV system

rows.actor: Laboratory responsible for the products it represents (marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay)
rows.quote: iii. Participar de otras actividades que podrán ser definidas por las autoridades ministeriales o a partir del trabajo coordinado entre los actores del Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: listed as a function/responsibility of laboratories (infinitive in a list of responsibilities), recorded as Mandatory. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: iii. Participate in other activities that may be defined by the ministerial authorities or arise from coordinated work among the actors of the National Pharmacovigilance System.

f.title: Report events that may put a large number of people at risk within 24 hours
f.statement: For events that may involve a risk affecting a large number of people, the laboratory must inform the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit within 24 hours of becoming aware, by the initial communication routes listed in the Ordinance.
f.clause: Anexo, III. Vías y plazos de notificación, b. Laboratorios responsables de los productos bajo su representación

rows.actor: Laboratory responsible for the products it represents (marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay)
rows.quote: Ante eventos que puedan implicar un riesgo que involucre un gran número de personas, informar dentro de las 24hs de tomar conocimiento, por las vías:
rows.location: Anexo, III. Vías y plazos de notificación, b. Laboratorios responsables de los productos bajo su representación
rows.review_note: Review: contact e-mail and telephone numbers omitted from the quote (contact details). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For events that may involve a risk affecting a large number of people, inform within 24 hours of becoming aware, by the following routes:

deadline_rule.applies_to: Events that may involve a risk to a large number of people

f.title: Follow the 24-hour alert with an eReporting Industria notification within 15 business days
f.statement: The initial communication routes used for the 24-hour alert do not replace notification through the e-Reporting Industria tool, which must be made within 15 business days.
f.clause: Anexo, III.b. Laboratorios responsables de los productos bajo su representación

rows.actor: Laboratory responsible for the products it represents (marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay)
rows.deadline: Within 15 business days (start not stated in the sentence; read as from awareness)
rows.quote: Estas vías de comunicación inicial no sustituirán la notificación a través de la herramienta e-Reporting Industria, y deberá realizarse en un plazo de 15 días hábiles.
rows.location: Anexo, III.b. Laboratorios responsables de los productos bajo su representación
rows.review_note: Review: deadline_rule removed because this sentence gives no clock start; the 15 business days most likely run from awareness, as in the neighbouring items. Contact details omitted from the quote. Double-check: kept below 90 because the start of the period is not stated.
rows.quote_en: These initial communication routes shall not replace notification through the e-Reporting Industria tool, which shall be made within a period of 15 business days.

f.title: Report all other cases through eReporting Industria within 15 business days of awareness
f.statement: All other cases that do not meet the large-scale risk criterion must be notified by the laboratory through the e-Reporting Industria tool within 15 business days of becoming aware.
f.clause: Anexo, III.b. Laboratorios responsables de los productos bajo su representación
f.applicability: All adverse events within the national system scope (adverse drug reactions, medication errors, ESAVI and others listed in II.a.i)

rows.actor: Laboratory responsible for the products it represents (marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay)
rows.deadline: Within 15 business days of becoming aware
rows.quote: Todos ios demás casos que no cumplen los criterios referidos anteriormente, en un plazo de 15 días hábiles de tomar conocimiento, a través de la herramienta e-Reporting Industria.
rows.location: Anexo, III.b. Laboratorios responsables de los productos bajo su representación
rows.review_note: Review: the 72-hour serious/fatal deadline in III.a applies only to health personnel, not laboratories; noted in the statement. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: All other cases that do not meet the criteria referred to above, within a period of 15 business days of becoming aware, through the e-Reporting Industria tool.

deadline_rule.applies_to: All other cases (not large-scale risk events)

f.title: Report every six months the pharmacies supplied with medicines under active pharmacovigilance
f.statement: For medicines under active pharmacovigilance, the laboratory must inform the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit every six months of the pharmacies to which it sold those medicines.
f.clause: Anexo, V. Procedimiento de uso de medicamentos con farmacovigilancia activa, a. Laboratorios responsables
f.applicability: Medicines and blood components under active pharmacovigilance listed on the Pharmacovigilance Unit website

rows.quote: i. Informar semestralmente a la Unidad de Farmacovigilancia del Ministerio de Salud Pública las Farmacias a las cuales se les comercializó medicamentos con farmacovigilancia activa.
rows.location: Anexo, V. Procedimiento de uso de medicamentos con farmacovigilancia activa, a. Laboratorios responsables
